data.title: Details
data.cuitInvalid: Check the CUIT: it has eleven digits and the last one is the check digit.
data.environmentHelp: Testing is for trying things out and its receipts have no fiscal validity.
data.aliasHelp: The name you will give the certificate in ARCA.
data.aliasInvalid: The alias has 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, and starts with a letter.
data.requiredHelp: Always: it brings the company's details.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.testingHelp: In testing, these steps are done in WSASS.
certificate.stepAlias: In ARCA, under “Digital certificate management”, add the alias “{{alias}}” with the request.
certificate.stepDownload: Download the certificate ARCA gives you.
certificate.stepAuthorize: Under “Relationship manager”, authorize {{services}} for the alias.
certificate.soon: The certificate expires on {{date}}. Renew it beforehand so invoicing is not interrupted.
certificate.expiredBanner: The certificate expired on {{date}}. You can't issue until you renew it.

checks.NotAuthorized: The service still needs to be authorized for the alias “{{alias}}”
checks.Blocked: ARCA won't accept another request until {{time}}
checks.ClockSkew: The server time doesn't match ARCA's

services.title: Services
services.authorize: Authorize {{service}} for the alias in ARCA and test the connection.

disconnect.title: Disconnect ARCA?
disconnect.description: The private key and the access tickets are deleted. To issue again, you'll need to generate a new certificate.

conflict.title: Review
conflict.text: Someone else changed the connection while you were editing it.

registry.title: Company
registry.help: The details come from the ARCA registry every time the connection is tested.
registry.empty: The company's details arrive with the first test.

invoicing.title: Invoicing · Point of sale
invoicing.help: Choose one no other system uses: the platform keeps the numbering.
invoicing.none: ARCA returned no web service points of sale for this CUIT.
